item.title: [No Priors] Powering AI-Driven Drug Discovery with President of Isomorphic Labs Max Jaderberg
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:24 The large part of the industry makes medicines is this very empirically driven process. Where things really fail is in the clinic because we never could see the problems until we get to the point where we put these drugs in patients and we say, Oh no, like, there's toxicity that we didn't account for. And so the really big opportunity is to have much more of that understanding before you go into patients. How can we bring all of that drug discovery work onto a computer?...
